title: RELATED reads the related one-side row from the row context of the many side
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", SUMX ( FILTER ( Sales, RELATED ( 'Product'[Color] ) = "Red" ), Sales[Amount] ) )

source.quote: you can access the row of a parent table using RELATED
source.supports: from a row context on Sales, RELATED gives access to the row of the parent table Product

source.quote: the function follows a chain of one or more many-to-one relationships to fetch the value from the specified column in the related table
source.supports: RELATED follows the many-to-one relationship Sales[ProductKey] -> Product[ProductKey]

derivation: Red products are Bike (1) and Helmet (2). Sales rows with ProductKey 1 or 2: rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 = 100 + 40 + 20 + 200 + 100 = 460.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
